normalized_text: a repository whose root package.json exists only to pin tooling matches the node row and receives a typescript rule scoped to globs that can never load there
decision_text: Rejected. The fingerprint reads manifests rather than walking sources on purpose, and no manifest-level signal separates a tooling-only manifest from an application one — the file that would settle it is a source tree, which is what the fingerprint declines to walk. The cost is bounded and self-correcting: the formatter stands down, the grants are inert, so what remains is one dead artifact that the retirement sweep classifies correctly on its own. More evidence would not move this, so it is not deferred.
